text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Taiki Shuttle asks me to meet her in the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I thought ya wouldn't show up, Trainer. Or should I say—outlaw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Your crimes stop today, ya hear? I hope you're ready to get a belly full of lead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You've been workin' up a storm lately, but I haven't seen one bit of relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're gonna burn up all the midnight oil with so much overtime! All work and no play is no laughin' matter!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So you're spendin' the day with me and giving that body and mind of yours some rest!
choice_data_list: My workload has been a little heavy lately…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Right? Here's the deal. I'm a gunslinger, and you're part of a band of outlaws!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Time to duel! Let's see who's the fastest gun in Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ready to square off? Soon as the bell rings, whip out your shooter and… bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My bullets blast right through evil, bringing peace back to the Wild West!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All righty—let's do this! Wait for it… Wait for it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding-dong, bing-bong…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that was a close one! And the winner is…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe… There's nothin' slow about your shot, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But you're too much of a greenhorn to match my quick draw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Know what happens if ya get hit?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It means you're dead and gone! Night night! So cut it out with the overtime and get to sleepin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, but ya won't be down-and-out forever! Once you're feelin' better, get on back here. I'll be lonely without ya around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki forces me to take a break. Thanks to her act of kindness, I'm able to get some much-needed rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm… You're a tough outlaw, ain't ya?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But ya slipped up. Ya shoot, you're guilty!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: See, I'm the sheriff in these parts. I gotta book ya now for shootin' somebody. And your punishment is…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're goin' straight to the hoosegow! Time to take a load off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It means I want ya to kick your feet up! It's not your fault—your weary bones are the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, off to the hoosegow with ya! And don't ya make a peep, or you're gettin' solitary!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not a hundred percent sure what she's saying, but it seems I've been given the day off to relax.
